translated: The Beningerslikken is a nature reserve on Voorne-Putten in the Dutch province of South Holland. This bird reserve is located three kilometers from Hellevoetsluis, near Oudenhoorn and Zuidland. Part of the former agricultural land - almost 300 hectares - is managed by Natural Monuments. It is an elongated reed-rutted area on the Haringvliet with pieces of grassland where grazing by cows takes place to keep it open.
